nodes.name: Payroll Cutoff Schedule
nodes.notes: Runs 8:00 AM on the 1st and 16th (semi-monthly: covers 16th-end of month, and 1st-15th). Timezone is Asia/Manila in workflow settings. Change the cron for weekly or bi-weekly.

nodes.name: Get Timesheets
nodes.notes: Replace with Clockify / Deputy / Jibble / biometric export. Expected fields per row: employee_id, name, date, clock_in, clock_out (ISO), break_minutes, ot_approved.

nodes.name: Get Approved Leave
nodes.notes: Expected fields: employee_id, name, date, type, days.

nodes.name: Get Holidays
nodes.notes: Expected fields: date, name, type (regular/special). Or replace with a static list.

nodes.name: Calculate Hours & Flags
nodes.notes: Tune STD_HOURS, SHIFT_START, grace period and holiday rules to your policy. Outputs HOURS only; the payroll system applies pay rates, premiums and deductions.

nodes.name: Wait for HR Approval
nodes.notes: Execution pauses until HR opens the approval link. Under Options you can set a timeout so it does not wait forever.

parameters.subject: =Approved payroll hours: {{ $('Calculate Hours & Flags').first().json.period_start }} to {{ $('Calculate Hours & Flags').first().json.period_end }}

nodes.notes: Swap for Outlook, or replace with a direct API call / upload to your payroll provider.
